question: A healthy 34-year-old woman comes to the physician for advice on UV protection. She works as an archaeologist and is required to work outside for extended periods of time. She is concerned about premature skin aging. The physician recommends sun-protective clothing and sunscreen. In order to protect effectively against photoaging, the sunscreen should contain which of the following active ingredients?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "UV exposure" -> "increased risk of photoaging" -> "skin damage" -> "wrinkles and fine lines" -> "premature skin aging" -> "concern for the patient" -> 80% CHAIN: "Sunscreen" -> "protects against UV radiation" -> "prevents skin damage" -> "reduces risk of photoaging" -> "recommended by the physician" -> 85% CHAIN: "Effective sunscreen" -> "contains active ingredients that block or absorb UV radiation" -> "provides better protection" -> 80% CHAIN: "Sunscreen active ingredients" -> "should include zinc oxide" -> "effective against UVA and UVB rays" -> "protects against photoaging" -> 80%
analysis: To effectively protect against photoaging, the sunscreen should contain physical blockers like zinc oxide or titanium dioxide, which provide broad-spectrum protection against UVA and UVB rays.
